blocks.text: Drag artists Khianna and Shae Shue K left fans gushing with their engagement announcement after seven years of being in a relationship. “Drag Race Philippines” alum Khianna popped the question to Shae while they were performing onstage during the “CAKE by Brigiding” theater show. Moments from the proposal were shared by Shae through her Instagram page on Thursday, Nov. 5. “Akala ko sa movie o teleserye lang to nangyayari, sa totoong buhay din pala. Akala ko part lang ng performance, totohanan na pala. At akala ko hanggang sana all lang kami, but this time finally engaged na kami at may forever […]...
